excerpt: ## Summary On the node's transact ingress, the write route is authenticated but the read route serving the node's delivered-note feed is not. `POST /transact/submit` rejects unauthenticated callers via `check_bearer`, while `GET /transact/scan` — registered in the same router, behind the same configured ingress token — never invokes the bearer check and returns every delivered note the node has seen (output commitment, ciphertext, mint) to any caller that can reach the port, including notes for settlements the node merely voted on, before settlement. ## Root cause Repo: `paraloom-core`, `main`
